intent: Illustrate that the same two gaps appear in any sector: retail customer records (NovaSmart's case), healthcare patient records, banking account data and manufacturing supplier data. In each, an unlisted agent plus a shared login means no one can prove who touched the data.

mandatory: Exactly four panels of identical size in one row; the first (Retail) is soft blue, the other three light grey
Each panel shows one icon, its sector name in bold near-black and its data line in semibold near-black (#1F2328), slightly smaller, never light grey

Every sector name and every data line sits on ONE line; 'Manufacturing' is the longest name and fits on one line with clear padding of at least 6% of the panel width on each side, so all four sector names use one smaller shared size if needed; no name is wrapped or hyphenated
The 'Illustration' tag is a small neutral rounded tag clearly visible at the top-right corner, level with the title
The bar is soft amber with both text parts in semibold near-black, each on one line, joined by one short arrow
The title is bold, large, top-left and on one line
The panels fill their band so there is no large empty area
Every panel, the tag and the bar have a visible 2px outline in their colour role's stroke colour
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide
The data lines ('Customer records', 'Patient records', 'Account data', 'Supplier data') and both bar texts are semibold near-black (#1F2328), never regular-weight grey
prohibitions: NO people, faces, hands, figures or characters; NO medical crosses, hearts, flags, currency signs, coins or factory chimneys with smoke
NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO green anywhere in the image
NO red anywhere in the image
NO check marks, ticks or crosses
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO light grey or faint text for the data lines
NO sector name broken across two lines (never 'Manufac-' / 'turing', never 'Health-' / 'care')
alt_text: The title reads: Same gaps, other industries, with a tag reading Illustration. Four panels, each with an icon: Retail with customer records, in blue; then, in gray, Healthcare with patient records, Banking with account data, and Manufacturing with supplier data. An amber bar beneath reads: Unlisted agent + shared login, with an arrow to: No one can prove who touched it.
